title: Zen Planner Alternatives: 11 Options Compared (2026)
description: Zen Planner alternatives compared on published prices: Gymdesk, Martialytics, PushPress, Wodify, WellnessLiving, Mindbody, RhinoFit and Kicksite.
h1: Zen Planner alternatives for gyms, dojos and studios
body:
Zen Planner's Studio plan costs $99/mo for 0-45 active members and rises by tier to $289/mo at 251+. Essentials (Studio plus website) runs $198-$388/mo and Ultimate (Studio, website and Engage marketing) $348-$538/mo. Add-ons are Engage $249/mo, Website $99/mo, a branded app $39/mo and a card reader $39/mo; Zen Planner Payments is custom-priced (Zen Planner active-member tiers and pricing, checked 2026-11-09). See the full tier table on our Zen Planner page. If you want published, predictable pricing or a different feature mix, here is what the main alternatives publish.

We checked each vendor's own public pricing page (Zen Planner, Wodify, PushPress, MatPilot, MatGoat and MAAT on November 9, 2026; the others between November 4 and November 7, 2026) and list only what they publish. Anything not published is marked unknown. We haven't used these tools ourselves and we don't publish ratings.

{{table:zen-planner,gymdesk,martialytics,pushpress,wodify,wellnessliving}}

The alternatives

  • Gymdesk: $75, $100, $150 or $200/mo with Gymdesk Payments for up to 50, 100, 150 or 250 active members ($100-$240/mo with your own processor). Month to month, no setup or cancellation fee, 30-day trial with no card. Gymdesk's tiers go up to 250 members, so you can compare them directly with Zen Planner's published tiers. See Gymdesk vs Zen Planner.
  • Martialytics: $69 (0-50 students), $99 (51-100), $129 (101-200) and $199/mo (200+), all features on every tier, unlimited users and locations, standard Stripe rates. Built for martial arts schools; 30-day trial with no card.
  • PushPress: Free plan at $0/mo (cards 4.99% + $0.30), Pro $159/mo (cards 2.89% + $0.30) or Max $229/mo (cards 2.75% + $0.30), unlimited members and staff on every plan, Rank Tracking for martial arts listed. Its FAQ lists a white-label Branded App add-on at $97/mo.
  • Wodify: a common pick for CrossFit and functional fitness gyms, which is also a big part of Zen Planner's market. Wodify's pricing page source lists Essentials $199, Accelerate $299 and Ultimate $499/mo list. The page banner says book a demo by Nov. 30 and save $100 every month (checked 2026-11-09), which would make them $99, $199 and $399/mo. The visible plan cards don't show prices, and the page's embedded summary still names an October 31 deadline, so confirm the price and deadline on the demo. Month to month, unlimited clients and staff, card rates from 2.7% + 30¢. Belt tracking starts on Accelerate, and there is an onboarding fee whose amount isn't published.
  • WellnessLiving: Starter $69/mo for one staff member, Business $199/mo and BusinessPro $349/mo with unlimited staff (10% off billed annually). Belt Progress Tracking is listed and data migration is free. A good fit for yoga and mixed-use studios as well as martial arts schools.
  • Mindbody: Starter from $79/mo per location. Accelerate and Ultimate prices aren't published. See Zen Planner vs Mindbody and our Mindbody pricing breakdown.
  • RhinoFit: $0 Start Up for 20 or fewer active users, or a flat $57/mo Standard plan with no member limits. No contract, 30-day trial with no card.
  • Kicksite: $49-$199/mo by student count, all features on every tier, 30 days free. Note that annual plans auto-renew and aren't refunded if you cancel early.

Cheaper alternatives for small martial arts schools

If Zen Planner's $99/mo entry price is the problem, these newer tools publish lower flat prices: MatPilot (Free at $0/mo + 2% on payments, or Pro at $79/mo + 0.49% with unlimited members), MatGoat ($40/mo for up to 50 students without payments, or $60/mo unlimited with payments and no MatGoat percentage) and MAAT ($59/mo, or $49/mo paid annually, plus a 1% transaction fee, unlimited members). Our cheap martial arts software guide compares them with RhinoFit, Kicksite, BJJLink and GymPoint.

How the published prices line up

For a school with 50 or fewer active members, the published entry prices are Martialytics $69, Gymdesk $75 (with Gymdesk Payments), RhinoFit Standard $57, and PushPress Free $0 (with a higher card rate), compared with Zen Planner Studio from $99. Above 50 members, compare Zen Planner's published tiers (Studio $133/mo at 46-60 active members, $189 at 76-100, $229 at 101-150, $289 at 251+) with Gymdesk (up to 250 members), Martialytics (200+) and Kicksite (101+). Flat-priced tools like MatGoat Professional ($60/mo) and MAAT ($59/mo + 1%) don't rise with member count. Our martial arts software pricing by student count page puts those tiers side by side.

Before you switch from Zen Planner

Zen Planner is month to month by default, with an annual contract available on request, so check whether you signed one. Then ask the new vendor three things: whether they import members, ranks and attendance history; whether stored payment cards can be moved from your current processor; and what onboarding costs (Wodify charges an onboarding fee, WellnessLiving says migration is free). Our software buying checklist covers the rest.

Which to pick

If you want every price published up front, look at Gymdesk, Martialytics or Kicksite. For the lowest monthly bill at a small gym, try PushPress Free or RhinoFit. For CrossFit-style workout tracking, look at Wodify or PushPress (Train is an add-on). For yoga and mixed studios with several staff, look at WellnessLiving or Mindbody. {{aff:gymdesk|Visit Gymdesk}} {{aff:martialytics|Visit Martialytics}}

faq: What is cheaper than Zen Planner?

For 50 or fewer active members, Martialytics ($69/mo), Gymdesk ($75/mo with Gymdesk Payments) and RhinoFit Standard ($57/mo) all publish lower prices than Zen Planner Studio (from $99/mo). MatGoat ($40/mo up to 50 students, $60/mo unlimited) and MAAT ($59/mo + 1%) are also cheaper. PushPress, MatPilot and RhinoFit Start Up have $0/mo plans, with a higher card rate on PushPress Free and a 20-active-user limit on RhinoFit Start Up (vendor pricing pages, checked 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-09; MatGoat, MatPilot and MAAT on 2026-11-09).
Does Zen Planner publish all its prices?

Mostly. Its active-member tiers page lists Studio from $99/mo (0-45 active members) to $289/mo (251+), Essentials $198-$388/mo and Ultimate $348-$538/mo, plus add-ons (Engage $249, Website $99, branded app $39, card reader $39/mo). Zen Planner Payments and multi-location pricing are by quote (zenplanner.com/pricing/active-member-tiers, checked 2026-11-09).
Is Wodify a Zen Planner alternative for CrossFit gyms?

Yes. Wodify is built for CrossFit, functional fitness and Jiu Jitsu gyms. Its pricing page source lists $199/$299/$499/mo list for Essentials, Accelerate and Ultimate, and the page banner says booking a demo by Nov. 30 saves $100 every month. Plans are month to month with an onboarding fee (wodify.com/pricing, checked 2026-11-09).
Which Zen Planner alternatives include belt tracking?
Martialytics, Kicksite, PushPress (Rank Tracking), WellnessLiving (Belt Progress Tracking), RhinoFit and Wodify (Accelerate and Ultimate only) all list belt or rank tracking on their own pages.
